rationale: 1 patch finding: test coverage gap for saturated navigation backgrounds leaves a potential contrast regression undetected beyond the black/white extremes the tests cover. 1 deferred: duplicate blend triple in rules.ts §3 (see code-review-deferred.md). 6 dismissed as noise (guards already present, constant prevents bad inputs, math correct at boundary, no orphaned callers).

findings.title: Missing test coverage for saturated nav backgrounds
findings.problem: The two WCAG AA contrast tests cover only #000000 and #ffffff as navigationBackground. No saturated mid-range background is tested, despite the fix's stated goal of working across all appearance presets.
findings.impact: A contrast regression on a custom colored nav background would go undetected. The old isDarkColor oklch-based heuristic and the new WCAG relative-luminance math diverge on saturated colors near the oklch L=0.5 boundary, so the fix may not generalize correctly to all real-world presets.
findings.recommendation: Add at least one test case with a saturated mid-range navigationBackground (e.g. #7c3aed or #1e40af) verifying contrastRatio(text, surface) >= 4.5 to confirm the WCAG AA guarantee holds beyond pure black/white.
